Type: architecture diagram

Diagram:
- Boxes/entities:
  - Discriminative Neural Network
    - Input: image of a cat
    - Output: 0.03 Bird, 0.92 Cat, 0.05 Dog, ...
  - Generative Neural Network
    - Input: "photo of a tabby cat" (text)
    - Output: image of a cat

- Connections:
  - image of a cat (Input) -> Discriminative Neural Network -> 0.03 Bird, 0.92 Cat, 0.05 Dog, ... (Output)
  - "photo of a tabby cat" (Input) -> Generative Neural Network -> image of a cat (Output)
